Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Okay this card:

Infection
Type: Combat
Requires: Thanatosis/Fortitude
Cost: 2 blood
[for] Prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes this round.
[thn] Prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or retainer) in combat. Usable by a vampire not involved in the combat.
[THN] Only usable at the end of a round in which this vampire successfully inflicted damage on the opposing vampire. Put this card on the opposing vampire. The vampire with this card cannot block the vampire playing this card.

Does the underlined text say the ghoul prevents all damage taken during the combat. Every single round...?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
No, you
- Prevent all damage
done to
- a ghoul in combat.

So if during the damage resolution step the ghoul is taking 1 (hand strike) + 2 (carrion crows) damage, you prevent that 3 damage at that time.
Damage dealt during additional strikes or subsequent rounds will have to be prevented by other cards.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
